repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
t1 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
delay(20 MIN)
t2 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
diff = t2 - t1
if (diff >= 3) {
    (#Study_AC).airConditioner_setAirConditionerMode("cool")
}

diagnosis.summary: The candidate adds an unnecessary absolute-value correction (lines 5-7) that alters the signed difference logic. F2 shows the IR took no action while the JoI took action, because the IR's condition ($t2 - $t1 >= 3) was false (3 - 3 = 0) but the JoI's corrected condition became true. The IR requires the exact signed difference without folding to absolute value.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value correction block. Restored the direct comparison of the signed difference ($t2 - $t1 >= 3) to match the IR specification exactly.
